_comment: Deliberate, reviewed divergences from the reference smali. Each entry must name the class, the method, and why the change is intended. The oracle reports anything not listed here as UNEXPLAINED - so this file is the record of every behavioural decision taken since the reconstruction reached equivalence.

deviations.reason: Reads BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME instead of a hardcoded string. Upstream kept the two in step by running sed over the smali at build time (reference/build.sh); this removes that drift permanently. Adds a generated BuildConfig class.

Bug fix: the lazy init is now guarded by synchronized (SettingsValues.class) - the extra class-literal constant is the monitor. IconLoader (ROADMAP 1.6 phase 3) calls getInstance from worker threads while binding rows, so two threads could each construct an instance and the later write replaced the one the main thread had already stored the selected gesture/pie/ISA slot in, losing the edit target. Surfaced as the intermittent SlotMappingUiTest ISA failure. Kept as a block, not a synchronized modifier, so the method signature is unchanged.

Bug fix: the bound was `mType <= names.length`, which indexes one past the end when mType equals the array length (reachable from a corrupted or hand-edited prefs file). Changed to `<`. See docs/ROADMAP.md 3.2.

The five prebuilt InputContext<sdk>.jar assets are replaced by one jar built from source by the :inputcontext module, so the SDK ladder that selected between them is gone. The variants only ever differed where hidden-API signatures changed between releases (ProfilerInfo, getRecentTasks().getList(), ActivityManager.getService(), moveTaskToFront's extra params); the rebuilt helper reaches those APIs reflectively, which defers signature resolution to runtime and lets one build cover every API level. See tools/inputcontext/README.md and ROADMAP 3.1.
ROADMAP 1.4: initialises the new search query field. See the new_members entry for the feature as a whole.

ROADMAP 1.4: onCreate no longer builds the list inline. It now gathers candidates once (gatherCandidates) and delegates display to render(), which re-runs on every filter change. Hence the large drop in references from this method - the work moved, it did not disappear.

ROADMAP 1.4: the icon load now calls the adapter's bounds-checked iconAt() instead of switching on AppSelectMode and indexing the activity's list directly. Same icons, but safe when the list is rebuilt under an in-flight task.

ROADMAP 1.5: adds a Backup section (Export settings / Import settings) with its own posOffsetBackup/posExportSettings/posImportSettings positions, shown regardless of feature mode; constructs SettingsViewHelper with the new (activity, fragment) constructor so it can route Storage Access Framework results back here. See the new_members entries for SettingsViewHelper.smali and SettingsViewFragment.smali.
ROADMAP 1.5: now delegates to the new (Activity, Fragment) constructor with a null fragment - SettingsViewActivity (dead code, never started) is the only caller that still uses this one-arg form.

ROADMAP 1.5: the Export settings / Import settings rows launch a Storage Access Framework picker (ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT / ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT) on API 19+ with a fragment to route the result to, falling back to the original InputDialog path-entry flow otherwise. The reference-only ColorDialog/InputDialog show() refs are the same devirtualization noise seen elsewhere in this method (show() resolves to the merged SettingsViewHelper$ANON receiver type instead of the builder base type) - not new behaviour.

ROADMAP 1.5: two new InputDialog subclasses (Export settings, Import settings) join this class's merged anonymous-subclass bucket - the pre-API-19 / no-fragment fallback for SettingsBackup.exportZip/importZip, reporting the result with a Toast.

ROADMAP 2.3: TaskerTask no longer needs root (see the Launcher.smali::doTaskerAction entry below), so its caption tag changes from [Root] to [None]. ROADMAP 2.1 then retags Menu, Screenshot and the Nova/Apex/Holo drawers, which gained an accessibility path: e.g. [Root] becomes [Accessibility (Android 9+)|Root] for Screenshot. ROADMAP 2.5: LastApp's caption says [Root|UsageStats] (it already fell back to UsageStats without root).

ROADMAP 2.3: runs the task via a plain sendBroadcast(TaskerIntents.runTask(...)) instead of shelling `am broadcast` through root. Same broadcast action and extra (net.dinglisch.android.tasker.ACTION_TASK / task_name) - only the delivery mechanism changes, now declaring the PERMISSION_RUN_TASKS manifest permission instead of needing a rooted device.

ROADMAP 2.3: TaskerTask opens Tasker's own task picker (ACTION_TASK_SELECT via startActivityForResult) when Tasker is installed, instead of the free-text name dialog; the dialog remains the fallback when resolveActivity finds no Tasker. See the new_members entry for the onActivityResult that receives the pick.

ROADMAP 3.5 fix: onInterrupt no longer clears instance/mInitialized. The system sends onInterrupt to every bound service whenever anything calls AccessibilityManager.interrupt() - 'stop your feedback', not a disconnect. Clearing state there left the service bound (Settings shows it enabled) but unusable until toggled off/on, the long-reported symptom. Now only logs.

ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1: drops the setUserVisibleHint(true) call. That ViewPager1-era API has no effect under ViewPager2's FragmentStateAdapter, which manages fragment visibility through fragment transactions instead.

ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1 raises minSdk from 15 to 21. Below API 21, D8 wraps calls to APIs added after minSdk in synthetic Launcher$$ExternalSyntheticApiModelOutline0/$$ExternalSyntheticBackport* bridge classes, to protect Dalvik's eager class verification on pre-Lollipop devices; ART (API 21+) doesn't have that verification behaviour, so D8 stops generating the wrapper and calls the framework/JDK method directly. ROADMAP 1.13 battery fix: when the gesture input source dies (root denied, so the 'su getevent' the native recogniser reads exits), Logic::run keeps calling read() on the closed pipe and burns ~96% of a core forever (measured on the test phone with Perfetto and top). The thread gains a tid field (initialised to -1) so the watchdog can read /proc/self/task/<tid>/stat: run() is overridden, so HandlerThread.getThreadId() is never set.
Records Process.myTid() before entering the unchanged loop. See the constructor entry.

ROADMAP 1.13 battery fix: when the gesture input source dies (root denied, so the 'su getevent' the native recogniser reads exits), Logic::run keeps calling read() on the closed pipe and burns ~96% of a core forever (measured on the test phone with Perfetto and top). Initialises the watchdog Runnable (mSpinCheck) and mSpinCpuTicks = -1.

ROADMAP 1.13: the gesture setup moved unchanged into startGestures(), which runs through RootContext.whenRootKnown once the background root check has an answer, and only when root is really granted (otherwise a toast says gestures need root). Without root the native reader spins on a dead 'su getevent' pipe. startGestures also resets the spin watchdog and posts its first check (a baseline after 2 s, the verdict 10 s later, then every 60 s on uptime, so it never wakes the phone). If the thread uses over half a core in a window, checkTouchServiceThread quits it and the native loop, and shows a toast. Before the reader starts, one su call on a worker thread kills readers earlier runs left behind (`cat /dev/input/eventN` survives its closed pipe under su) and lists the input devices; if the saved device doesn't report touch positions, the service switches to the touchscreen TouchscreenDetector finds and says so in a toast. The startup log counts the image folder's files through IconFolder.
Also removes the pending watchdog check.

ROADMAP 1.13: starting su only proves the binary exists; Magisk can still deny it (the test phone does), and every root command then fails silently while isRootAvailable() said true. After the shells start, startRootCheck() sends `id` to the already-open root shell on a worker thread and records GRANTED (uid=0) or DENIED (EOF / other uid). If su can't start at all, the state is DENIED right away. Initialises the state and listener list. GitHub #1: when no su binary exists (suExists), an unrooted phone, it logs instead of toasting 'Failed to get root permissions!', which showed on every cold start.

ROADMAP 1.13: starting su only proves the binary exists; Magisk can still deny it (the test phone does), and every root command then fails silently while isRootAvailable() said true. Now also false once the check says DENIED; while it is still running it answers as before, so nothing that worked is blocked by the check.

GitHub #1: encodes any drawable through toBitmap instead of casting to BitmapDrawable. Shortcut Maker returns its icon as a resource that loads as an AdaptiveIconDrawable; the cast threw ClassCastException in MultiSelectActivity.onActivityResult, crashing LMT, so the shortcut was lost and the restarted process toasted 'Failed to get root permissions!' on phones without root. A null drawable still encodes to null. Also scales the bitmap down to SAVED_ICON_MAX (192 px) before encoding: shortcut apps can return full-size bitmaps, which bloated the prefs and every backup.

GitHub #1: delegates to toBitmap, which replaces getBitmapFromDrawableV26 (see removed_members): bitmaps and adaptive icons as before, and other drawables (vectors, layers) now drawn too instead of returning null, which made resizeImage's createScaledBitmap throw.

_note_fields: The 11 `$assertionsDisabled` synthetic fields were removed along with their uses: jadx renders them as a constant `false`, they are never part of a real assert (no AssertionError anywhere in the app), and javac already inlined the constant. The oracle reports their removal as synthetic-only field differences. MultiSelectActivity also gains instance fields for the search query, the system-app toggle and the unfiltered candidate lists (ROADMAP 1.4).
_comment_new_members: Classes where NEW members are expected because a feature was added there. Additions are accepted; anything MISSING is still reported, unless the entry sets "reworked": true, which means the class was deliberately restructured: removals are expected too, field diffs are ignored entirely, and - since ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1 - so is the CONTENT of any method present on both sides (no per-method deviations entry needed for a reworked class). Every other class is unaffected either way and still gets full content comparison.

new_members.reason: ROADMAP 1.4: app-picker search and system-app toggle. Adds gatherCandidates/render/matches/isSystem and the options menu, plus fields for the query, the toggle and the unfiltered candidate lists. ROADMAP 1.6 phase 3 then becomes an AppCompatActivity with a MaterialToolbar and a RecyclerView/SectionedRows-backed Adapter: onItemClick is gone (replaced by handleRowClick, wired per-row in Adapter.onBindViewHolder), and mActivityInfos/mPackageInfos/mShortcuts are gone - the old onItemClick resolved a tap as mPackageInfos.get(position - 1), a position re-lookup that's unnecessary now that each row's model object (PackageInfo/ActivityInfo/ResolveInfo) is captured directly at bind time. That also removes the async-icon-loading race the reworked AppSimpleAdapter (ROADMAP 1.4, see removed_classes) was built to guard against by construction, not just defensively. Material 3 polish then inflates R.layout.multi_select: an inline search TextInputLayout inside the toolbar (no 'LMT' title) replaces the SearchView action view, and a 'Show system apps' filter Chip replaces the checkable overflow MenuItem, so onCreateOptionsMenu is gone and onOptionsItemSelected only handles Up. Same mQuery/mShowSystemApps state, same saveShowSystemApps persistence, same render(). GitHub #1: onActivityResult ignores a shortcut result without EXTRA_SHORTCUT_INTENT (or without data) instead of crashing, and logs it under the new TAG.
